name: sqlite_recover
description: Recover a CORRUPTED SQLite database (only after sqlite_query 'PRAGMA integrity_check' returned something other than ok). Stops the service using it, recovers into a new file, verifies it, swaps it in, keeps the old db as a backup and restarts the service. The user must type yes in their terminal first; if they decline, nothing changes. Find the service from the system config (e.g. /etc/nixos) before calling.

db.description: Absolute path to the database file

service.description: systemd unit that has the db open, e.g. podman-pihole.service, or none if nothing uses it
